reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist 100ml
reviews.text: I love it. It sprays so lightly and widely covers my whole face best for makeup! Spray it on to the applicator and wala you get a glowy base also best to spray after your skin care it really locks that moisture in! A product I will buy again for sure!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意。噴出嚟好輕，覆蓋範圍好廣，成塊面都照顧到，最啱用嚟化妝！噴落化妝工具上面，嘩，即刻有水光底妝；喺護膚之後噴都一流，真係可以鎖住水分！一定會再回購嘅產品！

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist 100ml
reviews.text: Love it! I’m already half way through the bottle and bought another one. The texture is not sticky at all and blends well with makeup
reviews.zh: 好鍾意！我已經用咗半支，仲買多咗一支。質地完全唔黏笠，同化妝品都好夾。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist 100ml
reviews.text: Feels good on the skin. I don't like that the beads seem to stick a bit in the bottle and ends up getting wasted. Seems a bit gimmicky with the beads. Not sure if I'll purchase again.
reviews.zh: 皮膚用落感覺唔錯。但係唔鍾意啲珠珠好似會黐住喺支嘢入面，搞到最後倒唔出嚟被浪費咗。珠珠嗰part睇落有啲嘩眾取寵。唔確定會唔會再買。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist 100ml
reviews.text: The product is very convenient and easy to use. It provides great hydration while absorbing quickly into the skin without leaving a greasy or shiny finish.
reviews.zh: 呢個產品好方便又好用。保濕力強，而且好快就吸收晒，唔會留低油笠或者光面嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist 100ml
reviews.text:
My best ever option to hydrate and soothe my skin after face washing. 
I take it with me as a solo skin care routine during my business trips. No need to carry all the rest. 
Like it
reviews.zh:
洗完面之後用嚟保濕同舒緩皮膚，係我歷來最鍾意嘅選擇。
我去公幹嘅時候會帶住佢當作獨立嘅護膚程序，唔使帶其他一大堆嘢。
鍾意。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist 100ml
reviews.text: I am kind of “disappointed” as the hype about this product is so big, but I seriously do not see any difference on my skin neither any difference compared with other products on the market.
reviews.zh: 有少少「失望」，因為呢個產品嘅口碑咁大，但我真係睇唔到皮膚有任何分別，同市面上其他產品比亦都冇咩分別。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist 100ml
reviews.text: Very refreshing and gives you immediate hydration after shower or washing faces. Safe to use after skin treatment. A must have in my skincare collection.
reviews.zh: 非常清爽，沖完涼或者洗完面之後即刻保濕。做完皮膚療程之後用都安全。係我護膚收藏入面必備嘅一員。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist 100ml
reviews.text:
お風呂上がりにとりあえずしゅっとつけられるミストを探していて、セラムを使っているので同じPDRNラインで揃えてみました。
特に悪いところもなく！
ミストは細かくて良いです。これ単体の使用ではなく、スキンケアまでの繋ぎなのであまり効果がわかりません。笑
reviews.zh:
一直想搵支沖完涼後可以即刻噴一下嘅噴霧，因為已經有用緊精華，所以揀咗同系列嘅 PDRN 線。
冇乜特別差嘅地方！
噴霧好幼細。呢支唔係單獨用，而係喺護膚程序之間做衔接，所以好難講有冇效果。笑

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
